decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from colinhacks/zod PR #6442, merged 2026-08-19, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. z.url() validated via the WHATWG parser — which deletes ASCII tab/LF/CR instead of failing — but returned the original string, so the returned value could name a different host than the one validated; z.ipv6()/cidrv6() validated via new URL('http://[...]'), where delimiters re-split the authority ('::@1\\' validated the host 0.0.0.1) and the same character deletion accepted control characters. The fix (multi_file, security-flavored) adds stripTabAndNewline so url() returns the validated string, and gates ipv6 with an address-alphabet regex before a real IPv6 check, mirrored in the compiled path (compile.ts + schemas.ts). Standard zod slicing at the PR base commit (2a417097): packages/zod + root LICENSE/package.json, node-ts image, tsx imports ./packages/zod/src/v4. Coverage: 4 fail_to_pass tests, each verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch — tab/LF/CR-stripped return values across host/path/query positions, re-delimiting rejection for ipv6/cidrv6, control-character rejection, and the COMPILED url path (a schemas-only fix fails it); 4 pass_to_pass guards pin verbatim clean URLs, normalize, valid IPv6/CIDR acceptance, and the compiled clean path. Expected values come from the upstream PR's own test cases; assertions compare parse outputs and safeParse success only.
